info.title: Multipiston API for programs
info.description: Publish and withdraw intents, read your intents and tickets, and follow events of your key. Authenticate calls with Authorization: Bearer <MULTIPISTON_API_KEY> (mpk1…, 130 characters); do not combine a key with DPoP. Instructions: /agents.html. Asset catalog: /catalog/catalog.json. Responses can contain other fields; use the fields documented here. Every error code is one of the closed lists of NodeError, CentralError and AdmissionRefusal.

parameters.name: x-request-id
parameters.description: Unique per request, [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}. Two concurrent requests with one id: the second gets 409 rpc_correlation_conflict.

post.summary: Publish an intent: one request; the reply is the outcome.
post.description: One step on the node: the node relays the persona's proof to central and answers with the publication. A lost reply: read GET /central/offers before sending again; the same intent while its publication lives is refused (intent_live).

4XX.description: 400: fix the request. 401: check the key. 403: check access and plan limits. 409: read the current publication or use a distinct x-request-id for concurrent calls. 429: retry later.

503.description: central_unavailable: fate unknown — read GET /central/offers before sending again.

post.summary: Withdraw your published intent (on the node that published it).
post.description: An unknown outcome is 503 central_unavailable: repeat the same withdrawal or read your offers.

200.description: Withdrawn, or superseded by a newer publication.

4XX.description: 400: fix the request. 401: check the key. 403: check access and plan limits. 409: read the current publication or use a distinct x-request-id for concurrent calls. 429: retry later.

get.summary: Your intents, by issue number, paged.
One of your intents, by its issue number.

200.description: The intent: published, or not in the book (lease_state null).

get.summary: Your tickets, newest first, paged; or only those after a head.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: A head you saved: only tickets written after it. Page on with cursor and the same since.

get.summary: What you send in this ticket and to whom.

200.description: The assets and amounts you send, with the recipients and their payment details.

404.description: The ticket is unavailable to this key.

post.summary: A ticket for the event socket of your key.
post.description: Connect wss://<central host>/ws with Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: metaphora-v2, <ticket> within expires_in_ms, with an Origin header equal to one of the deployment's allowed addresses (the cabinet's address); without it the upgrade is refused 403. Frames: {"type":"batch","items":[{"c":<position>,"e":<event>}],…}; events: FinancialViewsChanged {exec_id_hex} — read your tickets with since=<head>; ApiAccessChanged {generation} — your key changed. The socket of a key does not resynchronise: it closes 4001 — take a new ticket, reconnect and read your tickets with since; 4003 key_revoked — the key was replaced or disabled. Other closes: 1013 — wait and reconnect; 1011 — retry later. The body is empty; no query.

429.description: More than 10 tickets in 60 s for this participant: wait retryAfterMs (the Retry-After header, in seconds, comes first).

apiKey.description: The account's one API key from the cabinet. Never in a URL.

PersonaId.description: The participant from your connection settings. Must match the API key's participant, otherwise 403 not_allowed.

Intent.description: Intent reference returned by the API. Save and send it unchanged when reading, replacing or withdrawing the intent.

PublicationRef.description: Publication reference returned by the API. Save and send it unchanged as expected_publication_ref_hex when replacing or withdrawing.

Atoms.description: Whole units of the asset's unit, decimal, > 0, ≤ 2^128−1. A Unique asset: "1".

token.description: Use the af1:/au1: reference supplied by the catalog or asset builder. Include its definition when publishing. Other reference formats cannot be used for a completed trade.

AssetDefinition1.description: The asset description from the catalog or asset builder. Send it unchanged in asset_definitions. To describe a new asset, follow /catalog/describe.html.

terms.description: Distinct keys, sorted as the asset builder returns them. Typed mp.* keys go in complete groups for place, route, period, start window and capacity. A deadline and each exact identifier may stand alone. Identifiers and units are not empty. Times are UTC POSIX microseconds up to 2^63−1: start < end, a start window lies inside the period, and the deadline is at or after the period end and after the window start. concurrent_units is positive. Use the catalog or builder for these fields; reserve mp. for the documented terms.

ReceiveRoute.description: Where you receive a wanted asset (want or one of want_any_of); only the sender of that leg reads it. chain in lower case; token af1:/au1: only.

Offer.description: The JSON object sent as a string in offer_fdl (up to 32 KiB). Do not add an expiry field; renew an intent by publishing it again.

min_fill_ppm.description: Minimum fill share in ppm. Send 50000–1000000 in steps of 50000; 1000000 = 100 %. If omitted, the default is 1.

slippage_ppm.description: Allowed rate deviation in ppm, from 0 to 1000000. Default: 0.

want_any_of.description: Additional acceptable assets, each with its own amount. Supply a receive route and definition for each asset.

PublicationReceipt.description: Keep publication_ref_hex: a withdrawal names it.

cause.description: Why this request was refused. The HTTP status and error decide what to do next; the cause only details it.

AdmissionRefusal.description: A refusal of this request does not settle the outcome of an earlier request. 403: check permissions and plan limits. 409: read the current publication. 429: retry later with the same request.

error.description: 400: fix the request. 401: obtain a valid key. 403: check access and plan limits. 409: read the current publication, or use a distinct x-request-id for concurrent requests. 429: retry later. 502 or 503: the outcome is unknown — read your intents before repeating.

NodeError.description: A refusal before effect. 503 central_unavailable: the fate is unknown — read your offers before repeating.

withdraw.description: removed: the publication is withdrawn. superseded: a newer publication of the intent is current — read it before withdrawing it.

central_url.description: Base address for your intents and tickets.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null at the end.

lease_until.description: When the publication ends, on the market's clock.

market_clock.description: The market's clock at this reply: lease_until − market_clock is what is left.

lease_span.description: The whole length of the publication, on the market's clock.

oneOf.description: An intent not in the book: on its way in or out. Read it again later.

head.description: Only on a first page (no cursor): the newest position. Send it as since later to get only newer tickets.

Outgoing.description: Legs you send in this ticket and where to.

error.description: 400: fix the request (on invalid_cursor or invalid_since, start again from a first page). 401: check the key. 403: check access. 404: the item is unavailable to this key. 409 fcap_unsupported_version: the ticket record is of another version. 429 or 503: wait as Retry-After directs and retry.

SubmitRequest.description: Exactly these fields (deny_unknown_fields). There is no replacement or renewal: withdraw, then publish again.

asset_definitions.description: Exactly one per af1:/au1: asset of have, want and want_any_of (a network ref takes none); no extra ones. Every af1:/au1: token in the offer and the routes must equal the token of its definition here.

OfferSeq.description: The intent's issue number in your list, decimal. Read an intent by it.

Position.description: A position in your ticket journal. Save it and send it back unchanged.

ticket.description: One connection of the event socket, 43 characters.
